trigger: strict single-envelope q adaptation and equal-opportunity MST multimodal support both failed on the inspected 16-taxon development cohort
cohort: same 16 inspected Izu vascular-plant taxa; development-only

retained_layers.set_selector: exact greedy maximum newly covered public land-grid cells
retained_layers.fallback: k=1, q=1 pure geographic maximum coverage

support_scale.score: mean robust-scaled environmental distance to the k nearest training prototypes
support_scale.k1_identity: k=1 is exactly the current nearest-prototype support representation
support_scale.support_area_control: for every q<1 and every k, select exactly the number of grid cells selected by the current k=1 support mask at that q; k>1 changes only which cells are eligible, not support area
support_scale.candidate_policy_grid: all (k,q) combinations with k in {1,2,3} and q in the retained q list; q=1 is a single geometry-only control independent of k

inner_selection.rule: within each outer-training fold and budget, evaluate every feasible (k,q) policy on identical complete inner spatial folds; compute paired mean recall lift over geometry-only q=1; if no policy has positive mean lift, choose k=1,q=1; otherwise choose maximum positive mean lift
inner_selection.tie_break: exact ties prefer broader q, then smaller k

controls.fixed_k2_q10: two-neighbour local-support scale with q10 area held equal to k1 q10
controls.fixed_k3_q10: three-neighbour local-support scale with q10 area held equal to k1 q10

primary_question: can training-only nested selection of local prototype-support scale recover a stable K5 ecological lift over global maximum coverage without hard-coding q or k?
secondary_questions: does k2 or k3 at fixed q10 improve over k1 q10 under identical support area?
which k values are selected across outer folds when inner data support an ecological constraint?
hard_boundaries: No new environmental variable is introduced.
No q, K, radius, thinning distance, or field endpoint is changed.
No k value beyond the predeclared {1,2,3} family is added after outer outcomes are inspected.
Outer-held-out coordinates are invisible until k, q and all site sets are frozen.
Campanula field coordinates are not used.
Frozen 192 Practical Core taxa remain untouched.
If this support-scale family fails, retain the failure and move to spatial support scale rather than weight/variable/q/K/r tuning.
